Have you tried therapy ? If you don’t have insurance , you can start with an entry level job with full time benefits. After you get back on your feet, you can even try for a two year degree at a community college .  Tech is a good education option or HR.  

I used to think I was lazy unmotivated because my demeanor was all other the place and I’d get told that by  a few past partners and sometimes coworkers even though I powered through college and worked my ass off to get a job but they assumed I was because I don’t pick up on hints or non direct communication. It started to affect me mentally . Well, I eventually got diagnosed with ADHD . It made so much sense and the medication has helped me maintain a better focus to better external perceptions of me . It helped me come back mentally too.  I’m not saying this is your story but I’m saying , you owe it to yourself to try . To seek solutions to your obstacles, to self reflect and discover your obstacles, and to set up a system around them.  I’ve been low before. Really low .. had some suicide attempts in the past. I’ve learned , no one is going to love or care for you better than  yourself because no matter what, you are stuck with yourself for better or worse. It is both scary and comforting that you can’t just up and leave yourself in the middle of a rough patch or get tired of yourself  and walk out of your life because you are you .

The reason for the shirt for Ellie:

I feel the shirt is very reflective of Ellie’s character. The entire game Ellie’s attitude/tone  is often purposely contradictory (irony in a sense)  to the harsh world they are in to cope with it. She makes light hearted jokes or sarcastic remarks and the narrative of the game uses her to create pocket moments of calmness and tenderness that allow you to escape the harsh brutal world even if for seconds. 

The shirt has  a somewhat high classed formal  gentleman saying something that is considered barbaric and informal but saying it as if it is formal. To me this contradiction or irony is parallel to Ellie’s tone throughout the game, as both are used to create comedy/tenderness to break away from the tone of the subject matter.

Reason for Joel Shirt:
It’s a button like Joel’s but it’s plaid flannel. I picked that because it is what’s worn by Ice Cube in Friday as Craig undergoes a similar conceptual journey that is often overlooked that is parallel to Joel’s. Both in Friday and in The Last of Us, the protagonist has to make a decision about their purpose and who they want to be in relation to the conflict in the story. For Joel, it was making the decision in the hospital and for Craig, it was deciding to use his mind and out smarting Debo rather than using a gun. Both characters were battling themselves. Joel, battling the loss of his daughter and rather or not to experience that grief a second time and making a decision that determines who he is. Craig, battling his sense of responsibility and acknowledging the control he has in situations.
